reviews.text:
I recently had a stubborn pool leak that was driving me crazy—losing water fast and stressing about the damage and cost. I called Jaun for help, and from the first conversation, he was professional, responsive, and genuinely helpful.
He came out quickly to diagnose the issue (found it in a tricky spot that others had missed), explained everything clearly without any upsell pressure, and got right to work. Not only did he fix the leak efficiently and thoroughly, but he went way above and beyond: he checked the entire system, made a couple of minor adjustments to prevent future problems, cleaned up everything perfectly, and even gave me tips on maintenance to keep things running smoothly.
The quality of work was top-notch, the price was fair, and he was super communicative throughout. My pool is back to perfect—no more leaks, crystal clear, and holding water like it should. If you're in the North Texas area and need pool repair (especially leaks), do yourself a favor and call Jaun. He's honest, skilled, and truly cares about doing the job right. Highly recommend
reviews.author: Matt DeWitt

reviews.text: I love their services. Best people to work with. Very helpful and gives all the recommendation on how to maintain pool. Love their services. They do it in very affordable price too.

reviews.text:
We had plaster work done on our pool and couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, the team was professional, communicative, and clearly knew what they were doing. The prep work was thorough, the plaster finish came out smooth and clean, and the pool looks brand new again.
They showed up on time, worked efficiently, and left the area clean once the job was done. Any questions we had were answered clearly, and they made sure everything was done right before wrapping up.
If you’re looking for reliable plaster professionals who take pride in their work and deliver quality results, I’d absolutely recommend them.
reviews.author: Velázquez Quality

reviews.text: Juan did an absolutely amazing job detecting and fixing the leak in our pool. He was extremely knowledgeable and thorough throughout the entire process. He was able to identify and repair the leak within just two days. I highly recommend him!
reviews.author: Lori Wroblewski

reviews.text:
I had multiple bids to resurface my pool. I was so impressed with the initial conversation, I ended up choosing Plaster People.  And now that the work has been completed, I could not be happier.
Product is clean, looks and feels good. Thy found good ways to save me money in the process, and were amazing to work with.
Thank you Plaster People, it was a great experience for me and my checkbook!
reviews.author: Nick Walters
